- **dim** = “most” or “the” (in this context, likely “the” as in “the one”)
- **bakwhl** = “surveyors” (noun, plural)
- **siwetdiit** = “were” (past tense auxiliary verb, 3PL)
- **ehl** = “of” or “belonging to” (possessive or relational marker)

The stranger held his blanket back tightly because he was cold, since the wind was blowing so much.  
So a while later, the wind said, “He said:  
‘Okay, it’s your turn to take the blanket off the stranger.’”  
Well, so then the sun started and it got really hot when he came out.  
A little while later, the stranger took off his big blanket, because it was hot.  
The wind said:  
“Okay, it’s your turn to take the blanket off the stranger.”  

—
